description: This Kotlin source file defines a DialogFragment class 'ShareLinkToDialog' used to display a list of activities capable of handling a sharing intent, with options to exclude certain packages and an option to copy to clipboard. It includes internal classes for customizing the list adapter and static factory methods for instantiation.

classes.name: ShareLinkToDialog
classes.description: A DialogFragment for sharing links through various activities, filtering out specified packages, and providing an option to copy links to clipboard.

classes.name: ShareLinkToDialog.ActivityAdapter
classes.description: A custom ArrayAdapter to display ResolveInfo items (activities) with custom layout, icon, and label.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and returns the dialog with a list of activities that can handle the intent, excluding specified packages and optionally adding copy to clipboard.

methods.name: createSelector
methods.description: Builds and returns an AlertDialog allowing the user to select an activity for the intent.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of ShareLinkToDialog with specified intent and packages to exclude.
